rows.statement: A factorised audio-light critic trained with time-shift, other-song AND beat-trigger negatives on bar-synchronous tokens learns something beyond beat and loudness: it separates real authored light from beat-trigger light on held-out songs above chance, its best-of-8 ranking over rectified-flow samples changes when the critic is projected to its nearest additive model, and best-of-8 beats random-of-8 on human 'fits the music'. Without the beat-trigger negative it collapses to a beat detector and rewards the mode the model already occupies.
